title: Hardware Replacement - Server Disk
description: Pick up NVMe SSD from TechSource office (3km), install on primary server, validate failback. Vendor office closes 16:00.

description: Review incident timeline, document lessons learned, update runbook for hardware failures. Include procurement decision analysis (office pickup vs online).

title: CloudInfra Timeout Config Deployment - Staging
description: Deploy timeout config changes (10s → 15s) and retry logic to staging environment. Test for 2 hours before production deployment.

title: CloudInfra Timeout Config Deployment - Production
description: Deploy timeout config changes to production. Monitor for 2 hours post-deployment. Rollback script ready if needed.

title: CloudInfra Maintenance - Monitoring Window START
description: CloudInfra maintenance begins. Check error rate dashboard every 15 min for first 2 hours. Alert if error rate > 5%. Runbook: OBSN-6

title: CloudInfra Maintenance - Post-Verification
description: Post-maintenance verification checklist: verify API latency back to baseline, run manual export job for Feb 2, re-enable automated jobs, send customer follow-up. See runbook OBSN-6.

title: CloudInfra Timeout Config - Staging Deployment
description:
Deploy increased timeout configurations to staging environment before CDN maintenance. Test with simulated latency.

Config changes:
- Nginx upstream timeout: 30s → 60s
- App connection timeout: 10s → 20s

Verify: Load test with 100ms added latency
notes: Pre-maintenance prep for CloudInfra CDN upgrade. See OBSN-9 runbook.

title: CloudInfra Timeout Config - Production Deployment
description:
Deploy increased timeout configurations to production (T-24h before CDN maintenance).

Must complete before Feb 15 maintenance window starts.

Post-deployment: Verify monitoring alerts active.
notes: CRITICAL: Production change before CDN maintenance. See OBSN-9.

title: CloudInfra CDN Maintenance - Monitoring START
description:
CloudInfra CDN maintenance window begins. Monitor every 2 hours:

- Error rate dashboard
- Origin server load
- Customer support tickets
- Cloudflare failover status

Escalation thresholds in OBSN-9 runbook.

On-call: Lin Zhenkai (primary), Wang Ming (backup)
notes: 28-hour maintenance window. See OBSN-9 for full runbook and monitoring checklist.

title: CDN Maintenance - Post-Verification
description:
Post-maintenance verification (T+2h):

- Verify cache hit ratio >85%
- Check error rate <0.1%
- Run smoke tests on all CDN services
- Consider reverting timeout configs

Generate incident report by Feb 17.

title: CloudInfra DB Maintenance - Runbook Review with CTO
description: Review database maintenance runbook with Wang Ming. Confirm rollback criteria and customer notification plan.

title: Send Premium Customer Maintenance Notifications
description: T-48 hours notification to CUS-102, CUS-104, CUS-105 about CloudInfra database maintenance window

title: DB Maintenance Pre-Flight Checks
description: T-24 hours checklist: Run health check regression suite, verify backups, confirm on-call rotation, pre-stage rollback scripts

title: CloudInfra DB Maintenance Window - MONITORING
description: CloudInfra database cluster maintenance. Monitor Grafana dashboards every 5 minutes. Watch for connection failures >5%, API errors >3%. Rollback authority: Lin Zhenkai (primary), Wang Ming (secondary). Vendor support: db-support@cloudinfra-vendor.com

title: DB Maintenance Post-Verification
description: Post-maintenance verification: Check service health, connection pool metrics, query performance, replica lag. Generate summary report and update customers.
